title: This $19 Charger Pulls Triple Duty to Power Up Your Phone, Watch and Earbuds at the Same Time
summary: The 3-in-1 charging station can power up your tech essentials in minutes.
contentText:

With all the ways we stay connected these days, it’s not enough to have just one charger or charging device on hand.

Take my last trip to New York for example: I arrived to my hotel room with my phone at 20%, my Apple Watch down to 5% and my AirPods earbuds completely out of juice after I had used them for my cross-country flight. I only had one USB-C wall charger on me and began to sweat as I scrambled to decide which device to plug in first (spoiler: I decided it was important to have a working watch).

That night, I immediately got on Amazon and picked up this 3-in-1 charging station , which lets you power up your phone, smartwatch and earbuds all at the same time — and all on one compact, portable stand.

GOOD DEAL

3 in 1 Wireless Charging Station 

$19.99 $21.46 7% off

Buy Now ON AMAZON

Right now, Amazon is selling this popular 3-in-1 wireless charging stand for just $19.99. Listed as an “Amazon’s Choice” product, this was also my choice when I ordered a charger online. It also boasts five-star reviews from 85% of shoppers.

Unlike traditional chargers, which have to be plugged in individually, this charging station only needs one outlet to power up the entire unit. The rest of the charging is done via wireless charging pads. The pads are all MagSafe-compatible, which means they’ll align perfectly with Apple’s magnetic technology, to help your cell phone, Apple Watch and AirPods case stay safely (and securely) attached as they charge.

The 3-in-1 charger delivers up to 15W of ultra-fast charging. In my experience, my iPhone 16 Pro Max was fully charged in under two hours. My Apple Watch SE , meantime, was fully charged in less than 90 minutes.

While cheaper wireless chargers can often overheat, the manufacturer says this unit has built-in technology to ensure “efficient heat dissipation, optimized current and safe power delivery to your devices.”

Amazon

What I like: the flip-up stand lets my take FaceTime calls on phone, or watch content on it even as it’s charging. And when I’m done and ready to go, the 3-in-1 charger folds flat into a palm-sized unit that’s around the size of a large deck of cards.

This Amazon deal gets you the bestselling 3-in-1 charging dock, a USB-C power adapter, a USB-C to USB-C charging cable and a setup guide. I personally picked up the charging station in black though it also comes in a silver/white colorway.

The device is a must-have office or travel necessity. And, for a limited time you can snag it for under $20 during Amazon’s surprise sale. See full details here .
